validity.recommendation: Do not 'fix' the drawn route to match 2775 km — the published record for this exact project (Asaluyeh, Iran to Nawabshah, Pakistan, matching this row's StartLocation/EndLocation) is itself internally inconsistent, and the segment-level breakdown supports a total closer to the drawn 1781 km than to the sheet's 2775 km. A human should decide whether to (a) leave LengthKnown at 2775 with a ResearcherNotes caveat that multiple conflicting totals are in circulation, or (b) revise it toward ~1957 km using the segment breakdown below. Either way this is a judgment call, not something the route geometry should be forced to match.
validity.researcher_notes: En.wikipedia.org's Iran-Pakistan gas pipeline article gives a segment breakdown for the CURRENT bilateral (Iran-only-to-Pakistan, no India extension) project: 'stretches 1,172 kilometres (728 mi) through Iran' (902 km Asalouyeh-Iranshahr + 270 km Iranshahr-border) and 'In Pakistan, the length of the pipeline is 785 kilometres (488 mi)'. 1172+785=1957 km, which is within this row's route-integrity tolerance band against the drawn 1781 km geometry (1781/1957=0.91, band is 0.75-1.33) -- i.e. the drawn route is NOT an outlier against the segment-sum total. The SAME article separately states, without resolving which scenario it means: 'The length of the pipeline that would be supplied from the South Pars field has been given variously as 900 kilometres (560 mi), 1,035 kilometres (643 mi), and 2,775 kilometres (1,724 mi)' -- i.e. 2775 km (this row's current LengthKnown) is one of three different published totals for the same South-Pars-supplied line, and the article's own infobox uses 2775 without reconciling it against its own 1172+785 segment breakdown. My read: 2775 km most likely originates from the original trilateral Iran-Pakistan-India (IPI) 'Peace pipeline' concept, which included a further India-bound extension beyond Nawabshah/Multan that was dropped when India exited the project in 2009; this row's endpoint (Nawabshah, Pakistan -- not India) matches the bilateral IP scope, not the old trilateral IPI scope, which argues against 2775 being the right total for THIS row's extent. Follow-up this pass: this session's WebSearch quota (200/200) was exhausted before I could pull primary reporting (Dawn, Reuters, Petroleum Division Pakistan, NIGC), so I substituted DuckDuckGo-via-WebFetch queries for '785 km'/'2775 km' Iran-Pakistan pipeline figures -- these returned zero hits beyond this same Wikipedia page (no independent corroboration either way), and hydrocarbons-technology.com / nsenergybusiness.com project pages still 404, globalsecurity.org still 403's. No second independent source reached. Tier is low because the one source available is a tertiary compilation that documents its own numeric inconsistency rather than resolving it -- treat this as a well-evidenced open question, not a settled correction.
